title: Festivals
author: Shénbǐ
description: Chinese New Year, Mid-Autumn and Dragon Boat Festival: red envelopes, firecrackers, couplets, zongzi and a dragon boat for your world, New Year greetings, the old legend of the Nian monster as a short book, and 14 sentences to read.

words.hint: 春 spring + 节 festival. It's in January or February, but it welcomes the spring.
中 middle + 秋 autumn + 节 festival: the full moon in the middle of autumn.
In early summer: dragon boat races and 粽子.
新 new (you know it) + 年 year.

words.en: year (also Nián, the New Year monster)
words.hint: Legend says 年 was a monster scared off by red and loud noise: that's why New Year is red and loud.
Hung upside down on doors: 'upside down' 倒 dào sounds like 到 dào 'arrives', so fortune arrives.

words.en: red envelope (with money, a New Year gift)
words.hint: 红 red (you know it) + 包 packet.
炮 has 火 (fire) on the left: bang!

words.en: spring couplets (red New Year poems by the door)
words.hint: 春 spring + 联 pair: two lines of poetry, one on each side of the door.
粽 has 米 (rice) on the left.
龙 dragon (you know it) + 舟 boat.
烟 smoke + 花 flower: flowers made of smoke and fire.
过 to pass/spend + 年 year.
热 hot + 闹 noisy: hot and noisy, the way a party should be.
新年 New Year + 快乐 happy.
恭喜 congratulations + 发财 get rich. Children answer: 红包拿来! 'Hand over the red envelope!'

books.title: 年的故事
books.blurb: Why New Year is red and loud: the old legend of the Nian monster.

pages.en: Long, long ago there was a monster. Its name was "Nian".
tokens: year (also Nián, the New Year monster)

pages.en: Nian was big and very scary. Every winter it came to the village and ate chickens, ate sheep, and even ate people!
tokens: year (also Nián, the New Year monster)

pages.en: Everyone was very afraid of Nian.
tokens: year (also Nián, the New Year monster)

pages.en: One day an old man came. He was wearing red clothes.
Nian came. The old man set off firecrackers: "Crackle, bang, bang!"
tokens: year (also Nián, the New Year monster)

pages.en: Nian saw the red and heard the firecrackers, and got scared. It ran away!
tokens: year (also Nián, the New Year monster)

pages.en: Nian is afraid of red, and afraid of noise.
tokens: year (also Nián, the New Year monster)

pages.en: From that day on, every year people put up red couplets, hang red lanterns and set off firecrackers.
tokens: spring couplets (red New Year poems by the door)

pages.en: That is "passing the Nian": celebrating New Year. Happy New Year!

sentences.en: Do you have a red envelope?
The Spring Festival is very lively.
At the Mid-Autumn Festival you eat mooncakes.
There are dragon boats at the Dragon Boat Festival.
